title: Reconstruction of Upper Eyelid With a Newly Modified Cutler-Beard Technique With Tarsoconjunctival Graf
brief_summary: To study the results of a modified Cutler-Beard technique , using a contralateral tarsoconjunctival graft, in patients who underwent excision of large malignant tumors of the upper eyelid
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Upper eyelid defect after tumor resection

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous surgery
